During the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> a '''[[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] conman''' decided to carry out a scam. He entered a dim-witted [[Shikitari (species)|Shikitari]] insectoid named [[Carl]] into the [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] games. In fact, Carl was a collection of [[Pupa/Legends|pupae]], perfectly suited for gladiatorial combat, however this biological stage of his life cycle was extremely short, lasting only two standard [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. The Devaronian pocketed a sizable sum for Carl, snickering to himself that, in two days, his buyer would be the proud owner of a hardened chrysalis from which twelve harmless creatures would emerge.<ref name="CE" /> Nevertheless, Carl died in [[the Cauldron]] arena before he could transition to the next biological stage.<ref name="CW">{{CW|6}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Devaronian conman was first mentioned on the official [[Star Wars]] website, [[StarWars.com]], in [[2003]], and later in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', as an unnamed character who sold the insectoid Carl, thereby determining the latter's fate.
